svg.title: Household Capture & Import Journeys (Save & Back to Life · Era 3)
svg.desc: End-to-end journey map covering all four household capture paths: Save-and-Forget Async Capture (Photo, Web Link, Describe, PDF), Direct OS Share and Shared Recipe Bundle, Workflow Suspected-Duplicate Detection and Paired Human Review, and Failure Recovery plus Post-Import Quality Repair.
svg.text: WFS / Shared Table · Family Cookbook Era 3 · End-to-End Journeys
4 Capture Journeys · Save & Back to Life
Capture & Import Journeys: From Source to Trusted Library
Save-and-forget async capture with immediate return to Home, paired human duplicate review, and recoverable failures with zero dead ends.

g.text: Photo · Web Link · Describe · PDF → Zero waiting screen
• Photo: collapsed hub + Main dish toggle
Zero hub detours · Demo-safe local .txt path
• Member switch / background discards PDF draft.
• Demo mode gates AI via DemoAiActionGate
Works with Save-and-Forget · Zero library hunting
• Holds new copy out of Discovery voting
until reviewed; existing favourite stays clean.
• Keep existing · move new to Bin
• Keep new · move existing to Bin
Journey 4 · Failure Recovery, Quality Repair & Universal Capture Invariants
• Stays on capture form; draft retained.
• Uncertain reply warns of duplicate risk
• Household members report Ingredients or Steps + note → triggers contextual re-import
against retained source URL or original photos/PDF pages.
• Completed repair surfaces Review badge → human inspects → explicit Mark as resolved.
1. Save & Back to Life (Zero Forced Wait)
Every async capture returns straight to Home after 202 intake. Ambient Home status
reassures the household and offers 1-tap “+ Add another” without a 10s timer lock.
2. One Exit Grammar (Locked × · Zero Dead Ends)
Every capture state, including PDF Confirmation, keeps the locked top-right 48px ×
cancel control. No giant bottom Cancel buttons or trapped standalone-PWA screens.
Original photos and rendered PDF pages remain accessible via View Original. Suspected
duplicates link directly to their existing match for calm 1-tap human resolution.
4. Dual-Mode AA / AAA, Touch & Bilingual Parity
>= 48×48px targets, 2px outline-ink-body (4px offset), >= 12px floor, EN/FR, reduced motion.
